title: The Library at Mount Char
author: Scott Hawkins
summary: Carolyn and the others were taken in as children by a figure they call Father, and each was taught a single kind of powerful knowledge. When Father disappears, she has to act, and the cost is high.
readIf: you like strange, dark fantasy that mixes humour with real brutality and keeps surprising you.
skipIf: you are sensitive to graphic violence or cruelty toward children.

pairings.reason: Another fantasy about gods and mortals set in an ordinary American landscape, with a gentler tone.
A dreamier take on a hidden library and the people who guard it.
A short, unsettling story of a place that rewrites the rules of reality.
